# WellerTracker: oil and gas well activity by state

> A free site that tracks approved oil and gas drilling permits, spuds and rig counts for California, Colorado and
> Wyoming from each state regulator's public data, updated weekly. Built by Ryan Weller ([ryweller.com](https://ryweller.com)).
> California is the full permit explorer; Colorado and Wyoming are drafts.

## What the California page shows

- Approved well permits by operator, parent company, field, county, and CalGEM district.
- Work activity: New Drill, Existing (work on existing wells), and Abandonment. Functional well type: producer, thermal producer, injector, observation, and other.
- Weekly approved permits by work activity, and a since-last-week summary.
- Kern County New Drill permits vs. the SB 237 annual cap, with operator-reported spuds from the CalGEM Central District Drill Tracker.
- A map of permits over CalGEM field boundaries, and permit records with CSV export and links to each well's WellSTAR detail page.
- Filters are stored in the URL, so a filtered view can be shared as a link.

## What the Colorado page shows (draft)

- Approved ECMC drilling permits (Form 2) by operator, parent company, county and formation, weekly and monthly.
- Each permit's current well status, spud date and expiration, statewide spuds, and the undrilled permit inventory.
- Days from approval to spud, and weekly Baker Hughes rig counts for Colorado.

## What the Wyoming page shows (draft)

- WOGCC applications for permit to drill (APDs) by operator, county, reservoir and mineral ownership (federal, state, fee).
- Approvals, the pending queue, renewals shown apart from new-well APDs, and spuds.
- Weekly Baker Hughes rig counts for Wyoming.

## Pages

- [Well permit activity by state](https://permits.ryweller.com/): one card per state with the latest week's numbers
- [About](https://permits.ryweller.com/about/): sources and terms for every state
- [California well permit activity](https://permits.ryweller.com/ca/): the permit explorer
- [About / methodology](https://permits.ryweller.com/ca/about-methodology/): California data sources, definitions, and limitations
- [Colorado well permit activity (draft)](https://permits.ryweller.com/co/): ECMC permits, well status, spuds and rig counts
- [Wyoming drilling permits and spuds (draft)](https://permits.ryweller.com/wy/): WOGCC APDs, the pending queue, spuds and rig counts

## Data sources

California (CalGEM):

- [WellSTAR Notices](https://gis.conservation.ca.gov/server/rest/services/WellSTAR/Notices/MapServer/1): permits
- [WellSTAR Wells](https://gis.conservation.ca.gov/server/rest/services/WellSTAR/Wells/MapServer/0): well location, type, and status
- [CalGEM field boundaries](https://gis.conservation.ca.gov/server/rest/services/CalGEM/Admin_Bounds/MapServer/0)
- [CalGEM Central District Drill Tracker](https://www.conservation.ca.gov/calgem/Documents/Permits/Central%20District%20Drill%20Tracker.xlsx): Kern spud dates

Colorado (ECMC):

- [Approved Permits to Drill (Form 2)](https://ecmc.state.co.us/permits/?t=1)
- [ECMC GIS downloads](https://ecmc.state.co.us/data2.html#/downloads): wells layer (status, spud date) and undrilled permit layer (expiration)

Wyoming (WOGCC):

- [WOGCC Data Explorer](https://dataexplorer.wogcc.wyo.gov/): APD and well reports, spud dates

All states:

- [Baker Hughes rig count](https://rigcount.bakerhughes.com/na-rig-count): weekly rigs by state, and Kern County

Counts are approved permits, not wells drilled. Each state regulator is the authoritative source for any single permit.
